refinement_plan_1.analysis: High-priority review feedback highlights missing data properties for Organization (e.g., legalName, taxID, contactEmail, phone) and for Item (description, unitOfMeasure, productCode). These gaps affect full coverage of CQ5 (organization info) and CQ8 (item info). No constraint violations or structural errors are reported, but medium-priority suggestions include adding General Class Axioms (GCAs) for formalizing roles like Buyer/Seller and owl:equivalentClass axioms for classes with necessary/sufficient conditions. Low-priority: expand disjointness to more sibling classes (AgentRole, Identifier, Price, Tax). Plan: 1) Add missing data properties to Organization (legalName, taxID, contactEmail, phone, registrationNumber). 2) Add missing data properties to Item (description, unitOfMeasure, productCode, brand, model). 3) (Medium) Add GCAs for Buyer/Seller as subclasses of AgentRole, using restrictions. 4) (Medium) Add owl:equivalentClass for InvoiceMessage (required sections/roles). 5) (Low) Expand disjointness axioms to AgentRole, Identifier, Price, Tax. 6) Preserve all existing correct structure, properties, and annotations.
